tool_input.body: **Animation Architecture:** All keyframe definitions (@keyframes heroGradient, wordRotate, fadeInUp, logoScroll) are centralized in a global style doc (cloneAnimations) rather than inline per-component. Components reference animations by name via styleProperties.animation values. ##

**Per-app Knowledge Base (Manual Record)**

### **Overview**
clonelinear is a

public-facing SITE application that replicates the visual design and core user experience of linear.app. Built with a modern dark-leaning aesthetic (deep charcoal #0f0f12 background, purple #5e6ad2 accent), the app showcases issue tracking and collaboration features

through a landing page hero section, animated feature cards, partner logo strip, and multi-column footer. The LinearDark theme provides a cohesive design system across all pages with typography, spacing, and color tokens. Pages are authored section-by-section and validated structurally before visual deployment.

###

**Decisions Log**

**Animation Architecture:** All keyframe definitions (@keyframes heroGradient, wordRotate, fadeInUp, logoScroll) are centralized in a global style doc (cloneAnimations) rather than inline per-component. Components reference animations by name via style

Properties.animation values. This approach ensures consistency, maintainability, and avoids per-component CSS bloat. 

**CSS Approximation:** The linear.app source design features dynamic WebGL particle effects and complex animated gradients in the hero background. We approximated

this with a CSS-only `@keyframes heroGradient` loop (8s duration, hue-rotation-based color sweep) that delivers similar visual motion without JavaScript or canvas overhead. Trade-off: the CSS version is static and repeating rather than procedurally generated, but provides a lightweight

, declarative animation that fits the platform's design constraints.

---

refinement. All core decisions documented above.
